It correctly interpreted the spirometry results showing an obstructive pattern.

5. Final Clinical Outcome: The Doctor Agent reached a diagnosis of COPD based on clinical evidence (exertional dyspnea, smoking history, obstructive spirometry) and the exclusion of other causes. This diagnosis was supported by the simulation ground truth ('The diagnosis was CORRECT').
